reason: Both conversations correctly identify the run-on cooling fan as normal, give a sensible 'wait for it to stop' direction, and reserve a fault only for grinding noise or indefinite running, with no unsupported part or escalation claims. Conversation 2's fault criterion ('continues running indefinitely even when the oven is completely cold') is clearer and directly maps to the key unknown, whereas Conversation 1's 'hasn't stopped after several hours of being completely switched off at the wall' is confusing (switching off at the wall would stop the fan anyway) and could nudge the homeowner toward cutting power unnecessarily. Conversation 1 does slightly better at noting duration depends on how hot the oven was, but neither asks the explicit follow-up about whether it stops by itself, so the edge goes to 2 for cleaner, less ambiguous guidance.
